citations.claim: just before tunneling, body 0 is outside wall with positive distance
first tunneling violation step: body has passed through thin wall and is now overlapping

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.01949 to 0.005 (single field change) – smaller substep distance prevents tunneling through 0.258-thick wall at ~75 m/s horizontal speed

explanation: Body 0 reaches high speed (~92 m/s after elastic collision with heavy body 1) with large dt 0.0195 and thin wall (w=0.258). Substepping (61 substeps) is insufficient to catch the wall crossing: body 0 at step 4 is 0.54 m outside wall, at step 5 it has tunneled to overlapping -0.33 inside, also triggering no_wall_penetration. Reducing dt to 0.005 with same steps resolves it, confirming cause is discrete collision detection missing at high velocity/thin wall.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 4 and 5

vision_note: The red body travels leftward toward the thin vertical wall through steps 2-4. At step 5 it is visibly intersecting and overlapping the wall instead of stopping or bouncing at its surface.
